$description: Souvenir design tokens, version 0.2. Format: Design Tokens Community Group 2025.10. Three layers: primitive (raw values), semantic (purposes, each an alias to a primitive), component (a decision of one component that differs from a semantic default, each an alias to a semantic token).

primitive.$description: Raw values. Never used by a component or a screen directly; reached only through semantic tokens. A step is named by its value: neutrals by lightness times 100, dimensions by their size in pixels at a 16 pixel root, durations in milliseconds.

17.$description: Darkest grey: the ground and the well of the dark theme, and the ink on the light cost display in the dark theme.

22.$description: Ink of the light theme: all text and the focus ring.

23.$description: Raised panel of the dark theme, one step lighter than its ground.

25.$description: Dark display surface used for the cost display in the light theme.

32.$description: Hairline divider of the dark theme.

45.$description: Soft ink of the light theme: hints and secondary text.

53.$description: Control boundary of the light theme.

56.$description: Hueless solid fill for the information and busy tabs, in both themes.

62.$description: Control boundary of the dark theme.

74.$description: Soft ink of the dark theme: hints and secondary text.

85.$description: Hairline divider of the light theme.

92.$description: Ground and well of the light theme, and the light display surface in the dark theme.

95.$description: Ink of the dark theme: all text and the focus ring.

97.$description: Raised panel of the light theme, and the ink on the dark cost display.

99.$description: Near white for text and marks on solid fills, in both themes.

neutral.$description: Cool grey scale at hue 250 with a trace of chroma, so the greys read as slightly cool rather than warm or dead.

accent.$description: Accent fills. Only one is in use at a time, chosen by the semantic accent token or by data-accent on the root element. Each keeps 4.5 to 1 under near-white text and 3 to 1 against both themes' panels and grounds.

blue.$description: Default accent: a solid blue fill for the one primary action.

teal.$description: Alternative accent: a solid teal fill, selected with data-accent="teal".

status.$description: Status fills for tabs, the same in both themes. Hues are kept at least 30 degrees from every accent hue so a status is never mistaken for the accent.

danger.$description: Red fill for the danger tab: something failed or needs fixing.

warning.$description: Amber fill for the warning tab: check this before going on.

success.$description: Green fill for the success tab: it worked.

4.$description: Smallest spacing step, used by semantic space 1: a label to its control.

8.$description: Tight spacing step, used by semantic space 2: a mark to its words, and the error edge of a field.

12.$description: Spacing step used by semantic space 3: the gap between neighbouring controls.

16.$description: Spacing step used by semantic space 4: the default stack gap and the padding of pages and panels.

20.$description: Spacing step used by semantic space 5: between chat messages and above the page content.

32.$description: Largest spacing step, used by semantic space 6: between sections.

space.$description: Spacing steps on a 4 pixel base, named by their size in pixels.

6.$description: Small corner, used by the standalone status tab.

12.$description: Medium corner, used by controls, message plates and the cost display.

20.$description: Large corner, used by raised panels.

radius.$description: Corner radii, named by their size in pixels.

1.$description: Hairline width, used by dividers and the edge of a panel.

2.$description: Control boundary width; also the gap between a part and its focus ring.

3.$description: Focus ring width: thick enough to find at a glance.

4.$description: Heavy line width, used by the error edge of a checkbox: twice the control boundary.

width.$description: Line widths in device-independent pixels, named by their size in pixels.

sans.$description: The platform's own sans-serif: no download, familiar on every device.

16.$description: Body type size: the smallest type anywhere.

20.$description: Lead type size, used by level 2 headings.

24.$description: Title type size, used by the page heading.

28.$description: Long display type size, used by a cost summary total too long for the display size.

36.$description: Display type size, used by the cost summary total.

size.$description: Type sizes, named by their size in pixels. Nothing is smaller than 16 pixels.

600.$description: Semibold weight, for headings, labels, button labels and the total.

weight.$description: Type weights, named by their numeric weight.

120.$description: Tight line height, for headings and the large total.

150.$description: Reading line height, for body text.

line-height.$description: Line heights as a multiple of the type size, named by that multiple times 100.

1.$description: The size of content kept for screen readers but hidden from view.

2.$description: How far a key moves down when pressed.

20.$description: Size of a mark drawn inside a small tab, leaving a margin of the tab's fill around it.

24.$description: Size of an icon mark and of the checkbox box.

48.$description: Smallest height of any control, and the width of the solid tab on the leading edge of a plate.

96.$description: Smallest height of a multi-line text control: two control heights.

size.$description: Fixed sizes of parts and columns, named by their size in pixels.

120.$description: Quick state change: hover, press, border colour.

800.$description: One turn of the busy mark.

duration.$description: Durations, named by their length in milliseconds.

semantic.$description: Purposes. Each token is an alias to a primitive. Colours live in light and dark sub-groups with the same keys; everything that does not change by theme sits here directly.

color.$description: Colour roles of the light theme. The same keys exist in both themes.

panel.$description: Raised surface, one step lighter than the ground.

well.$description: Inside of a field: the ground showing through.

edge.$description: Boundary of a control: at least 3 to 1 against panel, well and ground.

divider.$description: Hairlines and the edge of a panel; decorative.

accent.$description: The one swappable token: a solid fill only, never text.

on-solid.$description: Text and marks on the accent and on status fills.

inverse.$description: Surface of the cost display: dark in the light theme, light in the dark theme.

danger.$description: Solid danger tab; the same in both themes.

warning.$description: Solid warning tab; the same in both themes.

success.$description: Solid success tab; the same in both themes.

neutral-solid.$description: Hueless solid tab for information and busy.

color.$description: Colour roles of the dark theme. The same keys exist in both themes.

panel.$description: Raised surface, one step lighter than the ground.

well.$description: Inside of a field: the ground showing through.

edge.$description: Boundary of a control: at least 3 to 1 against panel, well and ground.

divider.$description: Hairlines and the edge of a panel; decorative.

accent.$description: The one swappable token: a solid fill only, never text.

on-solid.$description: Text and marks on the accent and on status fills.

inverse.$description: Surface of the cost display: dark in the light theme, light in the dark theme.

danger.$description: Solid danger tab; the same in both themes.

warning.$description: Solid warning tab; the same in both themes.

success.$description: Solid success tab; the same in both themes.

neutral-solid.$description: Hueless solid tab for information and busy.

1.$description: Smallest gap: between a label and its control.

2.$description: Tight gap: between a mark and its words.

3.$description: Gap between neighbouring controls, wide enough that a focus ring never touches the next control.

4.$description: Default gap in a stack, and the inline padding of a page and a panel.

5.$description: Gap between messages in a chat and the top padding of a page.

6.$description: Gap between sections, and the inset that sets the person's message apart.

space.$description: Spacing steps for gaps and padding.

radius.$description: Corner radii, one per kind of part.

control.$description: Corner of a control, a message plate and the cost display.

tab.$description: Corner of a standalone status tab.

family.$description: The one font stack for all text.

size.$description: Five type sizes. Body text is 1rem and nothing is smaller.

body.$description: Body text, labels, controls and level 3 headings.

display.$description: The total in a cost summary: the largest reading on its page.

display-long.$description: A cost summary total too long for the display size: still larger than the page title.

strong.$description: Headings, labels, button labels and the total.

tight.$description: Line height of headings and the total.

control-multiline.$description: Smallest height of a multi-line text control, so it reads as a place for more than one line.

mark.$description: Size of an icon mark and of the checkbox box.

mark-inset.$description: A mark drawn inside a small tab, so a margin of the tab's fill shows around it.

tab.$description: Width of the solid tab on the leading edge of a plate, wide enough to carry a mark with space around it.

press.$description: How far a key moves down when pressed.

column.$description: Widest a single-column page may grow.

column-wide.$description: Widest a two-column page may grow, from the 48rem breakpoint.

visually-hidden.$description: Size of content kept for screen readers but hidden from view.

thin.$description: Decorative hairlines: dividers and the edge of a panel.

thick.$description: Boundaries of controls and link underlines.

heavy.$description: Heavy line: an error edge where the control boundary alone must visibly change shape.

offset.$description: Gap between a part and its focus outline.

duration.$description: Motion timing. Motion is removed when reduced motion is asked for.

quick.$description: State changes: hover, press, border colour.

loop.$description: One turn of the busy mark.

component.$description: Component decisions that differ from a semantic default. Each aliases a semantic token, never a primitive. A colour aliases its key under semantic.light.color; it resolves to the same key of whichever theme is active.

primary-fill.$description: Fill of the primary button: the accent, the only place it appears on a page.

primary-text.$description: Label and busy mark on the primary button.

primary-height.$description: Height of the primary button: taller than other controls.

press-depth.$description: How far a button moves down when pressed or busy.

error-edge-width.$description: Width of the leading edge of a control in error: the shape that carries the error besides the text.

textarea-min-height.$description: Smallest height of a textarea in a field.

arrow-size.$description: Size of the select's own arrow mark.

box-size.$description: Size of the drawn checkbox box.

error-edge-width.$description: Width of the edge of a checkbox in error: twice the normal edge, so the state is carried by shape as well as colour.

surface.$description: Surface of the cost display: the inverse of the theme.

total-size.$description: Size of the total: the largest type on the page.

total-size-long.$description: Size of a total with more than nine characters (data-length="long"), so it fits a phone-width display; still larger than the page title.

tab.$description: Fill of the error summary's tab.

tab-width.$description: Width of the solid danger tab on the error summary's leading edge, which carries the danger mark.

surface-on-panel.$description: Plate of a message placed on a panel (data-surface="well"), so the plate stays visible.

busy-duration.$description: One turn of the busy mark.

mark-size.$description: Size of the mark drawn on the status tab, smaller than the tab so its fill frames the mark.

person-inset.$description: How far the person's plate is inset from the leading edge.

person-edge.$description: Boundary of the person's plate, so it stays distinct in the dark theme.

draft-edge.$description: Dashed boundary of the drafted message: read, not yet sent.
